diagnostic_events.detail: First accepted diagnostic prefix is synchronously written and fsynced before its durable byte count is claimed. Fsynced progress snapshots are created before spawn and updated while streams arrive; timeout, stream error, and spawn error snapshots are attempted before child.close. Prior snapshot and durable .next preserve bounded evidence across a failed replacement. I/O errors stop ingestion and prevent successful availability classification. Independent virtual-I/O checks cover memory loss, timeout, stream errors, prefix fsync failure, snapshot rename failure and initial persistence failure.

Each stream ingests and hashes at most 1 MiB, including slicing an oversized final chunk to the remaining quota. On quota or persistence failure it pauses; later delivered callbacks cannot extend its ingestion/hash. Only the first 64 KiB is retained as durable raw prefix. Partial digests are explicitly INGESTED_BYTES_ONLY; complete digest requires EOF plus child.close with no stream failure/quota/persistence error.

preserved_constraints.environment: Literal allowlist; drops API/proxy/NODE_OPTIONS; no CODEX_HOME override; normal native configuration retained; owned TEMP and fresh empty C cwd.
preserved_constraints.launch: One pinned Native executable invocation, shell:false, detached:false, windowsHide:true, child.close awaited; no retry/PID kill/fallback.
preserved_constraints.success_gate: exit 0, no spawn error, no timeout, complete streams, exact MXC_OK newline stdout, no source drift, no observation errors; always resource_ready=false and product_can_submit=false.

runtime_prerequisites: Root must materialize and register a fresh exact scope from the inert templates, verify all executable/module/input pins, owned empty C cwd and owned TEMP, and retain original f13 suspended-create -> Job assignment -> resume containment before any Native invocation.

Any authorized actual probe remains one fixed-argv local no-model echo under the original 45-second execution / 5-second cleanup budgets and the stated Root total ceiling; failure or UNKNOWN must retain its scope and evidence without automatic replay.

Actual f13 final Job/process accounting, controller result and retained partial capture artifacts must be reviewed together. This static review does not establish actual MXC availability or actual hard-stop durability.

Even actual MXC_OK proves only startup availability. It does not prove split-read profile enforcement, product READY, or authorize another model attempt, saved configuration changes, installation, elevation, account/firewall changes or weaker sandbox/profile.
limitations: Fake-stream and virtual-I/O counterexamples exercise extracted declarations without importing the candidate entrypoint; they are not an actual Windows Job termination or MXC probe.
A durable .next file is diagnostic evidence only; it is not a completed success receipt.
A complete stream hash alone is insufficient for success; the wrapper also rejects timeout and observation errors.
